## Project overview
Binary classification problem to detect fraudulent credit card transactions.

## This notebook
- Data ingestion and quality checks.
- Feature engineering (date/time extraction, binning).
- Business validation rules.
- Train/test split with stratification.
- Explorative Data Analysis.
- ML pipeline: cross validation and metrics definition, preprocessing recipe based on EDA insight, workflow set creation (feature engineering, preprocessing post EDA and models).
- ML workflows' execution and evaluation.
- Best model choice and test.
- Model's explainability.

## Key challenge
- Severely imbalanced dataset (~99.6% legitimate, ~0.4% fraud).
- Proper handling of double preprocessing: pre and post EDA. Every manipulation must be applied on raw data to ensure deployability.
- Proper metric choice.
